summary: Blaize Holdings, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten follow-on offering of 18,918,918 shares of common stock at $1.85 per share, raising approximately $33.0 million in net proceeds. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3), with Northland Capital Markets as sole book-runner and Benchmark as co-manager. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event. The filing is an ordinary equity offering unrelated to any corporate-control transaction or restructuring.
